text: Time management matters a lot in todays fast-paced work environment. People who build strong organizational habits are better placed to hit deadlines and keep stress down. There's a few strategies that can help people get more done. First, prioritization is essential - figure out the most important tasks and do those first, so the critical stuff gets done. Second, cutting distractions makes a big difference. Blocking off time for focused work is widely considered beneficial. Finally, regular breaks matter for keeping performance up.
